title: Cyberbullying Detection for Low-resource Languages and Dialects: Review of the State of the Art

bias_targets.methodology: A systematic literature review analyzing the disparity in available datasets, model performance, and research quality between high-resource languages (like English) and low-resource languages/dialects in the context of automatic cyberbullying detection.

Qualitative evaluation of inter-annotator disagreement (resolving conflicts among three annotators from diverse backgrounds) to identify subjective biases in labeling cyberbullying, specifically concerning topics related to caste and religion.
